title: Concept: TLS verification override configured (php) — review required
description: In php, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEERs*,s*(?:false|0) disables a TLS authenticity check. Without verification, encryption still runs but against whoever answers — including an attacker. The remedy is restoring verification (default verification with CA bundle).
applicability: php TLS clients and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Machine-in-the-middle interception of all traffic on the connection; HIGH severity.
